correctness.rationale: The complete finite face poset has 107 nonempty simplices. The explicit 51-pair matching is checked against every cover and its directed Hasse graph is acyclic. Its only critical cells are one 0-cell and four 2-cells, so discrete Morse theory gives a wedge of four 2-spheres. Independent mod-2 boundary ranks and Euler characteristic agree.

value.rationale: The cube is the smallest genuinely three-direction Cartesian grid, making its matching complex a natural boundary case beyond the planar two-row grid literature. Determining its exact homotopy type, rather than only homology or face counts, gives a reusable benchmark for attempts to extend grid-matching methods to higher-dimensional Cartesian products.
